text:
deploy-bot: promo hold: canary failed during staging -> runner ephemeral volume mount timeout (artifact restore 504). blocking release window.
alex: ugh. saw this just now, any quick root cause?
monica: logs show the node kubelet couldn't mount the CSI volume within 2m. error: "MountVolume.WaitForAttach failed for volume \"ephemeral-abc123\": context deadline exceeded"
sam: notable that the runner pool started a bunch of jobs at once. maybe quota spike? cc @infra-oncall
infra-oncall: looking. checking node events and AWS EBS attach metrics. can we hold the promotion for +1h if needed?
ci-bot: canary job 4823 failed: restore step exited 1. snippet:
```
> time="2026-03-23T09:12:45Z" level=error msg="artifact restore timeout" attempt=3 dur=120s
> error: failed to fetch blob: http status 504
```
monica: artifact registry responded 504 on blob fetch retry 3. runner then hit mount timeout because pod couldn't attach after retry backlog.
alex: options: (1) pin to last-green image and manual promote, (2) rerun canary now and hope ephemeral resources free, (3) escalate to infra for capacity bump + wait.
sam: rerun now will likely hit same hotspot. we should avoid noisy retries during change window.
infra-oncall: verified a transient EBS attach spike in eu-west-1 at 09:10-09:14, recovered. but runner pool still has 18 pending attach attempts. recommended: drain few flaky nodes, restart attach-controller, then retry. can do in ~20-30m.
alex: given change window constraints I'd prefer pin-and-promote to keep release on schedule. we can follow up with a hotfix rollout of the canary after infra fixes.
monica: agree. pin to image sha sha256:0f5a9... from prod-promote-2026-03-22, annotate release notes: "promo held due to ephemeral volume mount timeouts; pinned to last stable image; will re-run canary post infra remediation."
alex: @deploy-bot can you apply manual pin and resume promotion of the control plane routes?
deploy-bot: ack. applying pin to release v2.7.1 -> image sha256:0f5a9... , holding canary jobs. logging action in release notes.
ci-bot: triggered manual promote workflow. smoke jobs queued.
sam: can we include a blameless note for ops in the release notes? short line: "staged canary pinned after EBS attach spike; infra investigating."
infra-oncall: will run attach-controller restart now and monitor; will update in #eng-infra. ETA 25m.
monica: thanks. tagging this in release tracker and leaving a follow-up task to rerun the canary and verify metrics before full traffic shift.
alex: decision: pin and promote -> follow up rerun in 30-60m after infra confirms attach backlog cleared. keeping release window. :thumbsup:
sam: adding a note to changelog and release notes draft.
deploy-bot: release action complete: manual pin applied, canary jobs suspended, promotion allowed for pinned image. action id: abcd-20260323-09.
infra-oncall: update: attach backlog dropping, no further 504s observed in artifact registry. will post final go/no-go for canary rerun in 20m.
alex: perfect. moving to monitoring and follow-up.
